request.prompt:
Use the attached exact project reference as the ONE dedicated KURTZ boss design. Broad blackened engraved full plate armor, huge spiked steel shoulder pauldrons, decorated closed horn-point helmet with dark visor slit, red neck cloth and skull clasp, LONG TORN SCARLET CAPE, wide long steel GREATSWORD in anatomical RIGHT hand, empty LEFT hand, no shield. Massive plated boots and gauntlets. Keep these same costume proportions and materials on every single sprite. Dark fantasy painted high-quality isometric game sprites, crisp full bodies, fixed camera looking down 25 degrees. NO TEXT, NO labels, NO gridlines, NO shadows, NO visual effects. TRUE transparent background. No clipped blade/cape/helmet/boots. Strict equal-cell grid with at least 12px transparent inset around each complete character in every cell. Never cross cells. All source pixels belong to isolated independent full-body sprites. Canvas portrait 1024x1536.
New dedicated SIX-frame SOUTH front-view running source, strict TWO COLUMNS x THREE ROWS, portrait1024x1536, every complete sprite fits its generous cell. Fixed front camera all6; visor, chest and red neckcloth visible identically eachframe, never turn or mirror the whole boss. Anatomical RIGHT hand remains on the LEFT side of screen holding greatsword; empty hand always screen-RIGHT. Keep sword nearly upright down the right flank, NO long diagonal reaching into another cell.
Reading order 0 upper-left: SCREEN-LEFT LEG extended in front and that LEFT-SIDE boot firmly supports weight; SCREEN-RIGHT boot is clearly far behind off ground. 1 upper-right: LEFT-SIDE support leg compressing and RIGHT-SIDE thigh swings forward. 2 middle-left: brief flight with RIGHT-SIDE thigh and boot reaching forward while LEFT-SIDE leg trails. 3 middle-right: SCREEN-RIGHT LEG extended in front and that RIGHT-SIDE boot firmly supports weight; SCREEN-LEFT boot is clearly far behind off ground. 4 bottom-left: RIGHT-SIDE support leg compressing and LEFT-SIDE thigh swings forward. 5 bottom-right: brief flight with LEFT-SIDE thigh and boot reaching forward while RIGHT-SIDE leg trails. Crucial: frames0 and3 must be opposite feet toward camera; do NOT reuse frame0 or put the screen-left foot in front again in frame3. Legs stay anatomically attached, face/costume/camera never swap. Cape sways according to the distinct phase, every pose complete and separated, generous40pxclear gutters. No ground shadow.
